Jun 19th 2026

Fashion, Futurism, and French Sensibility

Join Mikah Sargent, Leo Laporte, Joe Esposito, and Anthony Nielsen for the kickoff of Club TWiT’s new Media Club! The crew dives into 1997’s cult sci-fi favorite 'The Fifth Element'. They swap stories about their first exposure to the film, discuss its French creative influences, praise the unforgettable art direction and practical effects, and dig into its humor, cast, and memorable music—including the legendary Diva scene. Along the way, they debate whether Leeloo is truly the 'fifth element,' explore behind-the-scenes trivia, and reflect on why the movie remains a fan favorite. Don't forget to vote for what’s next in the Club TWiT Discord server!
